result.summary: The ninth trigger search was performed over a scope explicitly disjoint from the seventh and eighth rounds. Component (a) (structured-resultant and intersection literature) performed bounded network retrieval over structured, sparse, triangular, and black-box resultant computation and explicit intersection-theoretic computation; the arXiv export API was rate-limited (429) and intermittently unavailable (503), so the arXiv search UI was the fallback instrument actually used. The retrieved literature (general sparse resultant theory, the Poisson product formula, Wu/Ritt triangular decomposition) computes resultants from given polynomials (as determinants, root products, or via triangular decomposition); it does not construct r_R from E, P, Q, is not typed to the P1553 complete-chart structure, does not compute a remainder modulo the squarefree label polynomial g_I, and does not operate within the B^(5/4) budget. Component (b) (internal-corpus resource-check pass) re-read the open public r_R constructor obligation as an asset and searched knowledge/, inputs/, and the reachable ledger records for a theorem, bound, or correspondence that reads the complete-chart intersection structure as a resource; the answer is examined true, none found. Every candidate considered (C1 sparse resultant theory, C2 Poisson product formula, C3 triangular decomposition) is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8); each carries G1 present but fails G2, G3, and G8 (and G4-G7). The honest disposition is scoped_no_candidate.
